name: VISeek – Easy Custom Search
author: VillaTheme

sections.description:
WordPress’ default search is good – but maybe enough for you. If you’re looking for an easy custom WordPress search solution, you’ll need something else. Let’s see what’s missing and what you can achieve with VISeek.

WordPress search system is limited, hard to customize, and doesn’t give you insights into what people are actually looking for. Out of the box, it only looks through post titles and content, ignoring custom fields, taxonomies, or product details. Results are often sorted by date instead of relevance, so the most useful content doesn’t always appear first. It also doesn’t handle typos, synonyms, or stop words well, which can lead to empty or inaccurate results. There are no built-in filters for categories, tags, or post types, and users have to reload a whole new page for every query since there’s no instant or live search. On top of that, WordPress doesn’t provide analytics on what people are searching for, making it hard to optimize content. These gaps are even more obvious on WooCommerce stores, where product-specific needs like categories, tags, and attributes aren’t supported by default.

Try the Demo | Documents | Facebook group

How to install and use the plugin

FEATURES

  • Add unlimited search templates, as many as you need

  • Choose from 2 styles with full customization options

  • Replace the default WordPress search bar with VISeek forms

  • Enable AJAX-powered live search for instant results

  • Set minimum characters before search triggers

  • Decide whether to override the default results page

  • Filter out irrelevant terms with stopwords

  • Track user searches with detailed search logs

  • Analyze trends with built-in search reports

  • Add plugin processes (stopword filtering, user logs) to the main WP query for consistent results

Important Notice:

  • It is released on WordPress.org and you can use plugin as free to build themes for sale.

3rd party libraries & service

  • This plugin relies on Semantic UI, Select2, Chart.js, Chart.css, JqColorPicker to build the settings function to work properly.
    ► Semantic UI: Accordion, Button, Checkbox, Dimmer, Dropdown, Form, Grid, Header, Icon, Input, Label, Loader, Menu, Message, Modal, Progress, Segment, Tab, Table, Transition
    ► Select2
    ► Chart.js
    ► Chart.css
    ► JqColorPicker

sections.installation:
1. Unzip the download package
  2. Upload viseek-easy-custom-search to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
